name: matrix_m2
description: Paper 1 second pilot round on Gemma 3 1B IT (4-bit): descriptive control (control v2) for six seeds, intervention for three new seeds, the retrieved-context arm, the fixed-budget sensitivity and the sequential CT->IT extension. Reuses the matrix_m1 adapters (same tag, settings and code path) for seeds 101-103. Pilot round; no artifact is research-ready.
primary_contrast: on-target intervention minus off-target intervention (all three other targets) at 250 items; intervention minus descriptive control and intervention minus the first clean control are secondary
deviations_from_design: learning rate 1e-4 instead of 1e-5 (docs/PILOT_DECISIONS.md), chosen after the design setting produced no measurable learning; see runs/paper1/gate_lr1e-4/
familiarization uses 5 passes over the 400 items instead of 1
exact paired token budgets are not enforced; per-block token totals are recorded
generation and judging cover blocks 1, 5, 10 and 20 in this round, declared before any matrix result; adapters for all 20 blocks are saved
cross-target control added: off-target intervention models answer each target's questions at blocks 5 and 20
judge is one uncalibrated Haiku 5.5 reader per response, not the protocol's calibrated judge
primary contrast changed to on-target minus off-target intervention after the first pilot showed the matched clean control is not neutral
descriptive control (control v2) replaces the clean replacement in new runs and in both stages of the sequential extension; judged at blocks 5 and 20 only
seeds 104-106 run intervention and descriptive arms only; the first clean control is kept for seeds 101-103
fixed-budget and sequential arms use one assigned off-target control, not three
catalogue names and the ticker prefix have known collisions with real entities (data/paper1/identity_checks.jsonl) and have not been replaced
